auto_backup_help: Keep a copy of the current save before restoring, so you can go back. Turning this off saves time and space, but overwrites the current save without keeping a copy.
description:
Back up and restore your PS Vita saves.
Keep copies locally or on WebDAV.

restore_confirm_no_backup: Restore this backup? Automatic backup is off. Your current save will be overwritten without keeping a copy.
busy: Wait for the current task to finish
downloaded: Downloaded. Restore it from Local backups.
author: Author: jhq223
backup_confirm: Create a local backup of the current save? Close the game first.
